subject.title: Slack: support assistant.threads.setSuggestedPrompts for dynamic prompt suggestions

question: Should OpenClaw add configurable and dynamic Slack suggested prompts now, and should that surface be Slack-only or a portable channel/message-action API?
rationale: Current code already has the Slack API primitive and fixed defaults, but the remaining request changes public config and agent-facing action contracts while Slack's own agent surface is evolving.

options.title: Design the API first
options.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner chooses the stable config and dynamic-action boundary before implementation.

options.title: Implement Slack-only prompts
options.body: Add a narrow Slack plugin config and action path with schema, docs, and tests, accepting that this becomes a Slack-specific public surface.

options.title: Keep fixed defaults only
options.body: Treat the current default prompt seeding as enough and close after maintainers explicitly reject configurable or dynamic prompts for now.

recommendation.title: Design the API first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while a Slack/plugin owner chooses the stable config and dynamic-action boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history signal on the Slack assistant/config/action surfaces that would define this API boundary.
